title: LPTA trace record
description: One line of the JSONL trace emitted by src/LPTAInstrumentation.cpp: one object per pass invocation. schema_version follows independent SemVer from the tool itself — see the versioning note below. A new OPTIONAL field is a minor bump; a renamed/removed field or a changed meaning for an existing field is a major bump, and both old and new meanings must be documented in RESEARCH.md/CHANGELOG.md for at least one release cycle.

schema_version.description: SemVer of this schema. Records without this field predate versioning (schema_version 1.0.0, retroactively).

pass.description: LLVM pass name as reported by PassInstrumentation, e.g. 'SimplifyCFGPass'.

unit_kind.description: Granularity of the IR unit this pass ran on.

unit_name.description: Identifies the IR unit: bare function name for 'function' AND 'loop' kind (see the report layer's report_group_key() for why a viewer needs unit_kind too, not unit_name alone, to distinguish them), '<module:NAME>' for module, '<scc:...>' for SCC, '<unknown>' otherwise.

invalidated.description: True if the pass invalidated its IR unit outright (e.g. deleted a function). When true, none of the after_*/ir_changed/cfg_changed fields are present — the unit could not be safely re-printed.

ir_changed.description: Before/after printed IR text differs. Absent when invalidated=true.

lines_added.description: Line-level LCS diff of printed IR text; 0 when ir_changed=false. Falls back to a multiset approximation for module-scale text (see diffLines()'s size cap in LPTAInstrumentation.cpp) — treat as approximate above roughly 2000x2000 lines.

cfg_changed.description: Proxy signal: true if before/after basic-block count OR total successor-edge count differs. Not exact CFG isomorphism (see ROADMAP.md Phase 1 known limitations).

all_preserved.description: PreservedAnalyses::areAllPreserved() at the end of this pass.

dt_live_before_pass.description: Phase 2: was DominatorTree actually cached (computed and not yet invalidated) for this function immediately before this pass ran. Derived from AfterAnalysisCallback/AnalysisInvalidatedCallback tracking, not from PreservedAnalyses. This is the field that fixes Phase 1's over-firing: 'not preserved' only matters if something was there to preserve.

dt_wasted_recompute_count.description: Running count (monotonic within this trace) of times DominatorTree has been invalidated for this function AND later actually recomputed (i.e. some later pass asked for it again) — a measured cost, not a suspicion. 0 does not mean invalidation never happened, only that nothing has needed DT again yet.

incremental_update_candidate.description: Derived signal (Phase 2, liveness-aware): cfg_changed && dt_live_before_pass && !dt_preserved. Requiring liveness fixes Phase 1's coarser 'cfg_changed && !dt_preserved' (schema_version 1.0.0 records), which over-fired when DominatorTree simply hadn't been computed yet — see RESEARCH.md §5. A true value here now means DominatorTree was demonstrably cached and then discarded by a CFG-changing pass, not merely that it could theoretically have been preserved.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing per-process sequence number, assigned at emit time. Use this to order events within one trace file; do not assume it's stable across separate runs/LLVM versions.
